about: In the row, a Pane with no place opens by where it is opened from: by a click in a Group, into that Group; on a free workspace or from a column in no Group on its Project's workspace, right of the Pane in front; from another Project's workspace, and with none in front, first on its Project's workspace, right of the columns in no Group at its start. A Thread goes last on its Project's workspace, and so does what is opened for an Agent. A Pane of no Project goes right of the Pane in front, a Thread of none on the top free workspace. On the empty workspace at the bottom, on screen, what is asked for with nothing in front opens there.
